# amesh_role (Resource)

An AMESH authorization role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "amesh_role" "flow_operator" {
  key = "flow-operator"
  document = jsonencode({
    name         = "flow-operator"
    display_name = "Flow operator"
    permissions  = ["flow:view", "execution:create"]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Caller-owned immutable key, name or path.

### Optional

- `document` (String) JSON or YAML configuration document. Formatting-only differences are suppressed.
- `namespace` (String) Optional AMESH namespace for scoped resources.
- `secret_environment` (String) Environment variable expanded in-memory for ${AMESH_SECRET}; plaintext is never stored in state.

### Read-Only

- `applied_digest` (String) SHA-256 recorded after the last successful apply.
- `drifted` (Boolean) True when refresh differs from the last successful apply.
- `etag` (String) Latest server ETag when supplied.
- `id` (String) Stable provider identifier in kind|tenant|namespace|key form.
- `remote_digest` (String) SHA-256 of the redacted remote representation.
- `remote_document` (String, Sensitive) Canonical redacted server representation used for refresh and drift evidence.
- `revision` (String) Server-managed revision or resource version.
- `server_id` (String) Server-generated identifier when applicable.
